tasks.name: 创建笔记数据库模型
实现笔记数据库迁移
创建笔记API路由
创建笔记前端页面
实现笔记搜索功能

T1.implementation_approach: Define a database model for notes with fields like title, content, timestamp, and user ID using an ORM such as SQLAlchemy or Django ORM.
T1.notes: Ensure proper indexing for fields that will be frequently queried, such as timestamps or user ID.

T2.implementation_approach: Generate and apply database migrations using a migration tool like Alembic or Django migrations to create the notes table.
T2.notes: Test the migration in a development environment before applying it to production.

T3.implementation_approach: Set up API routes using a framework like Flask or FastAPI to handle CRUD operations for notes (create, read, update, delete).
T3.notes: Secure the routes with authentication and validation mechanisms.

T4.implementation_approach: Develop a frontend page using a framework like React or Vue.js to display, create, and edit notes, integrating it with the API.
T4.notes: Ensure the UI is responsive and user-friendly for better usability.

T5.implementation_approach: Implement a search feature in the backend using text search capabilities like SQL full-text search or Elasticsearch, and expose it via an API endpoint.
T5.notes: Optimize the search for performance and consider implementing filters for better results.

file_structure.purpose: Define the Note database model with fields id, title, content, created_at, and updated_at.
Create a migration script to initialize the notes table in the database.
Implement CRUD API routes for managing notes, including creating, reading, updating, and deleting notes.
Set up the Flask application factory and register the notes blueprint.
Entry point for the Flask application.
Create the frontend HTML page for managing notes, including a form for creating notes, a list for displaying notes, and buttons for editing and deleting notes.
Define the CSS styles for the notes management frontend page.
Implement JavaScript functionality for handling frontend interactions, such as form submissions and button actions.
Extend the notes API routes to include a search endpoint for finding notes by title or content.
Add a search input box to the notes management frontend page for searching notes by title or content.
Add JavaScript functionality to handle the search feature on the frontend.
